claims.text: The experiment evaluated the performance of hotel2vec embeddings by analyzing learning curves and the effect of hyperparameters on model performance.
The evaluation included calculating average similarity scores between hotels in the same market to assess how well market-level information was encoded in the embeddings.
The enriched model was compared to the session-only model, demonstrating superior performance in both filtered and unfiltered scenarios.
Evaluation involved using cosine similarity to find similar hotels and comparing enriched embeddings with session-only embeddings through examples.
